description: This script manages and lists hardware boards and architectures for a build system, providing functions to find and organize boards and architectures based on directory structures and configurations.

classes.name: Board
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a hardware board with attributes: name, arch, dir.

methods.name: board_key
methods.description: Returns the name of the board, used as a sorting key.

methods.name: find_arch2boards
methods.description: Finds and sorts boards grouped by architecture.

methods.name: find_boards
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all boards.

methods.name: find_arch2board_set
methods.description: Creates a mapping of architectures to sets of boards based on directory structure.

methods.name: find_arches
methods.description: Returns a set of architecture names found in given roots.

methods.name: find_arches_in
methods.description: Finds architecture directories within a root directory.

methods.name: find_arch2board_set_in
methods.description: Finds boards for specific architectures within a root directory.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for architecture and board roots.

methods.name: add_args
methods.description: Adds command-line arguments for architecture and board roots.

methods.name: dump_boards
methods.description: Prints the list of architectures and their boards.
